newsitem.title: USA: Continental Express orders 25 Embraer jets.
newsitem.headline: Continental Express orders 25 Embraer jets.

text.p: Continental Express Inc., the commuter carrier subsidiary of Continental Airlines Inc., said Tuesday it placed a five-year order for 25 Embraer EMB-145 50-seat regional jets, valued at $375 million.
The purchase from Brazilian private aircraft manufacturer Empres Brasileiro de Aeronautica, or Embraer, includes an option for 175 aircraft over the next 12 years.
Continental Express said the option will provide flexibility for additional growth or the replacement of its existing 100-aircraft turboprop fleet over the next decade.

Continental Express will be the first North American customer for the EMB-145, with deliveries beginning in December. Deliveries of the 25 aircraft are expected to be completed by the third quarter of 1998, making Continental Express one of the largest operators of regional jet aircraft in the industry, it said.
Continental's class A stock rose 25 cents to $22.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
